Thanks for contributing! Please read CONTRIBUTING.md first. Do not disclose security vulnerabilities in a PR; see SECURITY.md.

目标分支 / Target branch:
- Bug 修复（当前稳定版）/ Bug fix for the current stable release → `main`
- 新功能或行为变更 / New feature or behavior change → `dev`
-->

## 改动说明 / Summary

<!-- 这个 PR 做了什么，为什么？/ What does this PR change, and why? -->

## 关联 Issue / Related issues

<!-- 例如 / e.g. Fixes #123 -->

## 改动类型 / Type of change

- [ ] Bug 修复 / Bug fix
- [ ] 新功能 / New feature
- [ ] 新渠道或协议 / New channel or protocol
- [ ] 文档或翻译 / Documentation or translation
- [ ] 构建、CI 或打包 / Build, CI or packaging
- [ ] 重构或其他 / Refactor or other

## 测试 / Testing

<!-- 你如何验证了这个改动？运行了哪些检查？/ How did you verify this change, and which checks did you run? -->

## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] 目标分支正确，并已 rebase 到最新 / Targets the right branch and is rebased on the latest
- [ ] 已运行相关检查（fmt、clippy、test、console lint/test、docs）/ Ran the relevant checks
- [ ] Bug 修复已附回归测试（如适用）/ Added a regression test for bug fixes, where practical
- [ ] 用户可见的改动已更新中英文文档 / Updated English and Chinese docs for user-visible changes
- [ ] 新增文案已添加到 `en`、`zh-CN`、`zh-TW` / Added new strings to `en`, `zh-CN` and `zh-TW`
- [ ] 不包含任何密钥、Token、Cookie 或未脱敏的上游响应 / Contains no secrets, tokens, cookies or unredacted upstream responses
